name: One Frog, Two Frogs
source:
It's tough being a human! You have homework, your mom yells at you... good thing you've run away from home! But wait, who's this talking to you at this pond in the middle of nowhere? ...A frog?

[From [url=https://littlerat.itch.io/one-frog-two-frogs]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
做人真难啊！你有作业，你妈妈对你大喊大叫……还好你离家出走了！但是等等，谁在这个偏僻的池塘里和你说话？……青蛙？

[来自[url=https://littlerat.itch.io/one-frog-two-frogs]itch.io[/url]]
